question: 2024 年已完成订单的总 GMV 是多少？

question: 2024 年每月已完成订单的 GMV 是多少？

question: 2024 年 GMV 最高的 Top 3 品类是什么？

question: 2024 年销售额最高的前 5 款商品是什么？

question: 2024 年消费金额最高的前 5 位客户是谁？

question: 2024 年销量最低的 3 款商品是什么？

question: 每位客户最近一次已完成购买的日期和渠道是什么？

question: 按 2024 年销售额给各品类排名。
gold_sql: WITH category_sales AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, ROUND(sales, 2) AS sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM category_sales ORDER BY sales_rank, category

question: 计算 2024 年每月 GMV 及累计 GMV。
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_gmv FROM monthly ORDER BY month

question: 计算 2024 年各月 GMV 的月环比增长率。
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month), compared AS (SELECT month, gmv, LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_gmv FROM monthly) SELECT month, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - previous_gmv) / previous_gmv, 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM compared ORDER BY month

question: 2024 年每个月各渠道 GMV 的月内排名是多少？
gold_sql: WITH channel_month AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month, o.channel) SELECT month, channel, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS gmv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS channel_rank FROM channel_month ORDER BY month, channel_rank, channel

question: 每位客户第一次已完成购买的日期是什么？

question: 对比 2023 年和 2024 年的已完成订单 GMV。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: 按月份对比 2024 年 GMV 与 2023 年同期 GMV。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2023' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2023, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2024 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 2024 年每个季度的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

question: 对比 2024 年上半年和下半年的 GMV。
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN '上半年' ELSE '下半年' END AS half_year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY half_year ORDER BY half_year DESC

question: 对比 2024 年 11 月和 12 月的 GMV。

question: 2024 年星期几的已完成订单 GMV 最高？
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%w', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS weekday, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY gmv DESC, weekday LIMIT 1

question: 2024 年每月订单完成率和取消率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS completion_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已取消' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 2023 年每月新增客户数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(c.signup_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date >= '2023-01-01' AND c.signup_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 2024 年各品类 GMV 占比是多少？
gold_sql: WITH category_sales AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category), total AS (SELECT SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv FROM category_sales) SELECT category, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * gmv / total_gmv, 2) AS share_pct FROM category_sales CROSS JOIN total ORDER BY category

question: 2024 年各渠道已完成订单量占比是多少？
gold_sql: WITH channel_orders AS (SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders FROM channel_orders) SELECT channel, order_count, ROUND(100.0 * order_count / total_orders, 2) AS share_pct FROM channel_orders CROSS JOIN total ORDER BY channel

question: 2024 年各渠道的订单完成率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS completion_rate_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY o.channel

question: 2024 年各渠道平均每个已完成订单包含多少件商品？
gold_sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel) SELECT channel, ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units_per_order FROM per_order GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel

question: 已完成订单客户中的复购客户占比是多少？复购定义为至少有 2 笔已完成订单。
gold_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct FROM customer_orders

question: 2024 年各品类的实际成交价相对商品标价平均优惠比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / SUM(oi.quantity * p.price)), 2) AS discount_rate_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 按注册月份统计客户数，以及注册后 30 天内完成首购的客户占比。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(c.signup_date, 1, 7) AS signup_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS purchase_30d_rate_pct FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = '已完成' AND julianday(o.order_date) - julianday(c.signup_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_month

question: 个人和企业客户从注册到首次完成购买平均需要多少天？
gold_sql: WITH first_purchase AS (SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(julianday(f.first_order_date) - julianday(c.signup_date)), 2) AS avg_days_to_first_purchase FROM customers c JOIN first_purchase f ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: 2023 年注册的客户中，有多少人在 2024 年完成过购买？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS retained_paying_customers FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.signup_date >= '2023-01-01' AND c.signup_date < '2024-01-01' AND o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: 2024 年 GMV 中，新客和老客分别贡献多少？新客定义为首次完成购买发生在 2024 年。
gold_sql: WITH first_purchase AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_purchase_date FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT CASE WHEN f.first_purchase_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN '新客' ELSE '老客' END AS customer_type, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM first_purchase f JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY customer_type ORDER BY customer_type

question: 2024 年各月 GMV 为什么变化？请拆解订单数、每单件数和平均成交单价。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS units_per_order, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / SUM(oi.quantity), 2) AS avg_unit_price, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 为什么 2024 年 GMV 相比 2023 年发生变化？按渠道计算两年 GMV 和变化额。
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2023' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2023, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE -oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 2) AS gmv_change FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY gmv_change

question: 按品类分析 2024 年销售额相比 2023 年的变化来源。
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2023' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sales_2023, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sales_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE -oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 2) AS sales_change FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_change

question: 按客户城市分析 2024 年 GMV 相比 2023 年的增减贡献。
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2023' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2023, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE -oi.quantity * oi.unit_price END), 2) AS gmv_change FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv_change
